title: map pan from centre select jumps listing
name: Map pan from centre select jumps listing
rule: Map pan updates from centre; select centres the marker and jumps the listing. Popup snapshot + further-info link; dismiss via close and when another point is selected. Overlapping points → cluster. Filter labels name the input (postcode / suburb / full address).
pass_when: Pan is from centre; selecting a point centres it and moves the listing; popup has a further-info link and dismisses on close or next select; overlaps cluster; filter labels name the input.
fail_when: Select does not update the listing; overlapping points unclustered; unnamed filter inputs.
overview: Map pan centres; select centres the marker, updates listing, and clusters overlaps.
apply_when: Interactive maps with listings, popups, clusters, and named filters.
not_when: Select that does not update listing, unclustered overlaps, or unnamed filters.
agent_hint: Pan from centre; on select centre marker and jump listing; cluster overlaps; name filters.
description: Map pan updates from centre; select centres the marker and jumps the listing. Popup includes a snapshot plus further-info link; dismiss via close and when another point is selected. Overlapping points cluster. Filter labels name the input (postcode, suburb, full address). Pass when those behaviours hold. Fail when select does not update the listing, overlapping points are unclustered, or filter inputs are unnamed.
